title: glosa blackbox note
description: tier: positional/Dr (specified; independently unreviewed). Implements FOUNDATION_v0.5.md §2.3 (Blackbox Note, chair ruling A1 -- supersedes Register Zero/R0). Raw verbatim human lines, never edited in place (a correction is a new line) or translated in place, plus the append-only `cooking:` log. Renamed from schema/r0_record.schema.json per chair ruling A1 (REPO_SPEC_v0.5.md). Namespace https://glosa.example/ is a placeholder.

session_id.description: SESSION_ARCH_v0.4_SPEC.md §2.1/§2.2 (SA-1, build_now). Groups Blackbox Note lines belonging to one logical AI/human session; joined against hypothesis_selection.yaml, problem_card.yaml and kg_edge.yaml by this same key rather than a new session.yaml file (one-fact-one-home, §2.2 -- pending founder ratification of that decision, §7 item 1). Additive/optional.

session_boundary.description: SESSION_ARCH_v0.4_SPEC.md §2.2 (SA-1, build_now): the session boundary + AI-reset fact lives here, not in a new artifact. `retained_direction` (expansion|tunnel|unknown, NC-77) is deliberately NOT duplicated here -- one-fact-one-home places it on schema/hypothesis_selection.schema.json instead; this object never re-states that value. Additive/optional. Pending founder ratification of §2.2's logical-join decision (§7 item 1).

ai_state_at_boundary.description: Literal 'reset' only (sources/notes/EPISTEMIC_FUSION_v7.1.txt:328 -- m^{AI}_{s+1,0}=0 by architectural scope definition). Cross-file check (two notes sharing session_id split by a real process restart must BOTH carry this literal) is kernel-enforced, not schema-enforced -- see kernel/glosa_kernel.py `check_session_boundary_reset`. Unnumbered pending founder ratification of §2.2 (this is not one of kernel rule29/30).

entry_anchor.description: SESSION_ARCH_v0.4_SPEC.md §2.1: ref -> Problem Card, the H0 term of ENTRY_H->AI = H_0 ^ V_0 ^ C_0 ^ R* (sources/notes/EPISTEMIC_FUSION_v7.1.txt:351). Names the problem_card.problem_id this session's dialogue opened against. Additive/optional.

privacy_scan.description: Required before any line goes public (template's own gate).

question_trace.description: SESSION_ARCH_v0.4_SPEC.md §9.1/§9.4 (schema.blackbox-question-trace, build_now). Per-turn question-evolution trace INSIDE this one note -- distinct from `session.question_trace[]` below (Problem Card refs opened this session, SA-3 scope). Real gap this closes: `question_human`/`question_readout` on a Claim Card are single-shot (design/FOUNDATION_v0.6.md:495); nothing records how the live question changed turn-to-turn. NOT grounded in "glosa's own Human Return Test" (no such thing exists in glosa's own design docs -- that phrase is a sources/notes/EPISTEMIC_FUSION_v7.1.txt:467 construct glosa has not adopted; ships on the real, narrower single-shot gap alone, per §9.1's claim-wording fix). Additive/optional -- a note with one unchanging question simply has a one-entry trace.

derived_from_line.description: lines[].n this question grew from, or null for a genuinely fresh question (never silently omitted -- see tools/blackbox_log.py's coverage-check extension).

allOf.description: privacy_scan must be 'done' before any line in this note is marked public (a schema-checkable subset of the template's own gate).
